title: Sordland/Turn03/Budget Feedback
description: Symon Holl arranges a cabinet meeting for the government budget. Election promises are laid out and and a debate over what to invest where is made. Each minister strongly makes their position clear. The player is forced to make a balancing act between following election promises, keeping the cabinet satisfied and making a balanced budget. This is a major economic turning point with political outcomes.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“This is a disgrace. Rumburg is at..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is a disgrace. Rumburg is at our doorstep and the Armed Forces already have a laundry list of problems. This was a grave mistake that we will surely pay for in time.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you everyone. I appreciate y..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you everyone. I appreciate your time and effort.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you everyone. I appreciate your time and effort.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Regardless of what happened, I wou..."
entries.dialogueText: “Regardless of what happened, I wouldn't be here without you. Don't forget that we are a team.”
entries.menuText: “Regardless of what happened, I wouldn't be here without you. Don't forget that we are a team.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“For those who didn't like the deci..."
entries.dialogueText: “For those who didn't like the decisions, don't take it personally.”
entries.menuText: “For those who didn't like the decisions, don't take it personally.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian seemed as if he was about to..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian seemed as if he was about to say something, but looked down at his notepad when Iosef eyed him.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“It is an honor to serve with a Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is an honor to serve with a President that respects the military. Trust me, with these funds our armed forces will be better than ever before."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“It is a shame that the military wo..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is a shame that the military won't be getting an increase. I will have to make sacrifices to maintain our defense.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The continuation of the existing s..."
entries.dialogueText: “The continuation of the existing set of budgetary conditions is in order.”
entries.menuText: “The continuation of the existing set of budgetary conditions is in order.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Thank you for this decision, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for this decision, Mr. President. I knew you would see reason on this, considering our internal security threats are at an all time high.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I'm not sure what we'll be able to..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not sure what we'll be able to do if the budget doesn't change.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I heavily disapprove. We are barel..."
entries.dialogueText: “I heavily disapprove. We are barely making ends meet on the security side. I will be forced to reduce our force size and salary.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our new priorities called for a re..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our new priorities called for a reduction of law enforcement.”
entries.menuText: “Our new priorities called for a reduction of law enforcement.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The reduction of the budget might..."
entries.dialogueText: “The reduction of the budget might also put as in a tight spot regarding our ability to handle the amount of court cases.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I suppose we'll have to make do wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I suppose we'll have to make do with what we have. This is not the best situation for us.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I still disagree with Ms. Graf on..."
entries.dialogueText: “I still disagree with Ms. Graf on how the money ought to be spent, but the increased funding is certainly a step in the right direction.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Let's hear from Mr. Beniwoll.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's hear from Mr. Beniwoll.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Maintaining the funding was the co..."
entries.dialogueText: “Maintaining the funding was the correct call especially in light of the threats.”
entries.menuText: “Maintaining the funding was the correct call especially in light of the threats.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Concessions had to be made with th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Concessions had to be made with the military budget. The priorities have changed.”
entries.menuText: “Concessions had to be made with the military budget. The priorities have changed.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“That covers all branches. Each min..."
entries.dialogueText: “That covers all branches. Each minister will approach you with their respective policy requests and expectations over the next year.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I'm honestly rather disappointed...."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm honestly rather disappointed. The reduction will force us to shut down many hospitals and reduce service quality. It will also reflect badly on us as a government.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Thank you, sir. This health budget..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, sir. This health budget increase will help me to focus on improvements. Our people will now be safer than ever.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I can't say that maintaining the f..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can't say that maintaining the funding is negative but I don't think our services will perform any better.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara was eager to comment."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara was eager to comment.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The military is next.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The military is next.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Exactly. This was a big mistake. I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly. This was a big mistake. I'm so sorry, Ciara.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Keeping the same budget will just..."
entries.dialogueText: “Keeping the same budget will just result in the same problems. However, I prefer this over a decrease. I'll try to reform the system with my own resources.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“A reduction!? This is the opposite..."
entries.dialogueText: “A reduction!? This is the opposite of what we need. Such a shame that this money will go where it's less needed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Education is our future and it wil..."
entries.dialogueText: “Education is our future and it will not be sidelined. Our focus on it is clear, Ms. Walda.”
entries.menuText: “Education is our future and it will not be sidelined. Our focus on it is clear.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Thank you, it is great to see a po..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, it is great to see a positive change in the attitude of the administration for the first time in a decade.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Surely a well-funded and larger Mi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Surely a well-funded and larger Ministry of Education would benefit everyone.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“The increase of funding is very we..."
entries.dialogueText: “The increase of funding is very welcome. We can finally go after some comprehensive improvements by building new schools and improving the education system.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Thank you for your time and partic..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your time and participation in this significant moment. The meeting is concluded.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ministers bid their farewells -..."
entries.dialogueText: The ministers bid their farewells -- some excitedly, others dejectedly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cabinet slowly dispersed out of..."
entries.dialogueText: The cabinet slowly dispersed out of the White Room. The budget for our term was concluded.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“You have kept your promise to focu..."
entries.dialogueText: “You have kept your promise to focus on the military. An honorable and fitting decision.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“On top of it, you did not keep you..."
entries.dialogueText: “On top of it, you did not keep your promise to focus on the military. I will remember this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef squeezed his fists."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef squeezed his fists.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We have a very healthy budget surp..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have a very healthy budget surplus left for investments and other expenditures. Splendid!”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“It looks like we have a balanced b..."
entries.dialogueText: “It looks like we have a balanced budget with no deficit or surplus. Not bad. Not bad at all.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had finished allocating the gover..."
entries.dialogueText: I had finished allocating the government budget, to the satisfaction of some cabinet members and the dismay of others. They and I knew this would define a significant part of our term.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We have a deficit on our hands. We..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have a deficit on our hands. We will need to resort to debt to finance future investments. This situation can have adverse effects if we don't strike a balance.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara clearly wasn't finished, but..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara clearly wasn't finished, but didn't interject. Iosef chimed in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia and Lileas were both smiling."
entries.dialogueText: Nia and Lileas were both smiling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas leaned forward and put her h..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas leaned forward and put her hand on her chin. Nia was looking down at the floor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia and Lileas were frowning. When..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia and Lileas were frowning. When I looked at her, Lileas shook her head.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The military is on the top of my p..."
entries.dialogueText: “The military is on the top of my priority list and always will be. Rest assured.”
entries.menuText: “The military is on the top of my priority list and always will be. Rest assured.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“It will be harder to do so but I s..."
entries.dialogueText: “It will be harder to do so but I shall find ways, it is my duty.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“Is there a higher priority than ou..."
entries.dialogueText: “Is there a higher priority than our national security? I doubt it.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“The threats called for an increase..."
entries.dialogueText: “The threats called for an increase. Not just a continuation of the same budget.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“I knew I could count on your decis..."
entries.dialogueText: “I knew I could count on your decision-making, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“With your talent and experience yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “With your talent and experience you will overcome the issues our military faces.”
entries.menuText: “With your talent and experience you will overcome the issues our military faces.”

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: "“With the support you have provided..."
entries.dialogueText: “With the support you have provided, I will protect this country from any threat.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef leaned back in his chair."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef leaned back in his chair.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“We will tackle corruption and the..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will tackle corruption and the backlog of cases head-on.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We will be able to achieve positiv..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will be able to achieve positive results in the coming year. I can assure you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Law enforcement is a key branch th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Law enforcement is a key branch that needs a greater budget due to the increased threats and need for security.”
entries.menuText: “Law enforcement is a key branch that needs a greater budget due to the increased threats and need for security.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No, that should be all.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No, that should be all.”
entries.menuText: “No, that should be all.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Any statements on the matter, sir?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Any statements on the matter, sir?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Next up is health. Let's continue...."
entries.dialogueText: “Next up is health. Let's continue.”
entries.menuText: “Next up is health. Let's continue.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I trust you to push the Ministry o..."
entries.dialogueText: “I trust you to push the Ministry of Interior and Justice forward.”
entries.menuText: “I trust you to push the Ministry of Interior and Justice forward.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Disappointing for the people who w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Disappointing for the people who want a sense of justice returned. The backlogs won't get solved. The administration will hurt.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“With the reduction, our work will..."
entries.dialogueText: “With the reduction, our work will be hampered and made more difficult.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Justice will be served in this nat..."
entries.dialogueText: “Justice will be served in this nation and having more support is a step in the right direction.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We will make a good use of these n..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will make a good use of these new resources and fight crime, terrorism and subversives.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Troubled times are ahead for our m..."
entries.dialogueText: “Troubled times are ahead for our ministries.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“These are disheartening changes. W..."
entries.dialogueText: “These are disheartening changes. We will try to mitigate.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“We may not have the resources to m..."
entries.dialogueText: “We may not have the resources to meet new challenges, but I will find ways to help this nation.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Our expectations were much higher..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our expectations were much higher than this.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Well then. Let's start with law en..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well then. Let's start with law enforcement.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Let's hear the Minister of Educati..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's hear the Minister of Education.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Your expertise and passion should..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your expertise and passion should enable you to make the necessary changes for improvement.”
entries.menuText: “Your expertise and passion should enable you to make the necessary changes for improvement.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My expectation is that you maintai..."
entries.dialogueText: “My expectation is that you maintain education services with the same budget.”
entries.menuText: “My expectation is that you maintain education services with the same budget.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We can move on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We can move on.”
entries.menuText: “We can move on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This government has defined its pr..."
entries.dialogueText: “This government has defined its priorities, and education is not on the top of the list.”
entries.menuText: “This government has defined its priorities, and education is not on the top of the list.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Our future depends on our children..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our future depends on our children. Education is the first step in the fight against ignorance.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“We will be able to achieve my gran..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will be able to achieve my grand goals with these new budgetary resources.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“It seems we have no other choice b..."
entries.dialogueText: “It seems we have no other choice but to depend on what little we have. What will our children think of us?”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“It's not even on the list. Cutting..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's not even on the list. Cutting our funding will result in disaster."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Sure... Let's move on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sure... Let's move on.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Thank you for your confidence in m..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your confidence in me, but without extra funding we'll have to make sacrifices. And our system will see the consequences.”

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: "“Welfare must remain a priority for..."
entries.dialogueText: “Welfare must remain a priority for our term. There is no other way around it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Healthcare is very important for u..."
entries.dialogueText: “Healthcare is very important for us and as we move forward, it will improve drastically.”
entries.menuText: “Healthcare is very important for us and as we move forward, it will improve drastically.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Your opinions were noted, Paskal...."
entries.dialogueText: “Your opinions were noted, Paskal. Your task is to improve the care in the country.”
entries.menuText: “Your opinions were noted, Paskal. Your task is to improve the care in the country.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It is best we continue our funding..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is best we continue our funding as it is. You will have to find new resources.”
entries.menuText: “It is best we continue our funding as it is. You will have to find new resources.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sadly, health ended up in the list..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sadly, health ended up in the list of budget cuts. Not much can be done about it.”
entries.menuText: “Sadly, health ended up in the list of budget cuts. Not much can be done about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's wrap it up.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's wrap it up.”
entries.menuText: “Let's wrap it up.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“It feels invigorating to have the..."
entries.dialogueText: “It feels invigorating to have the weight of the government behind my cause.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“With the new budget we have many o..."
entries.dialogueText: “With the new budget we have many options to improve our healthcare program and provide for the people.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“The Ministry of Health will resort..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Ministry of Health will resort to a privatization effort to create funds to improve services.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“It is very unfortunate. I will hav..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is very unfortunate. I will have to look into privatising parts of our system to create funds in order to maintain operations.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Let's.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Which will be very difficult to ac..."
entries.dialogueText: “Which will be very difficult to accomplish without an increase in funds.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Agreed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I am also planning to tackle issue..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am also planning to tackle issues like the lack of rural hospitals and the recently worrying numbers of maternal deaths.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Dismissed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Dismissed.”
entries.menuText: “Dismissed.”

entries.dialogueText: “Here I was thinking the Rayne administration would be on the side of law and justice.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Our efforts will be on maintaining..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our efforts will be on maintaining order with what we have.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We have a good budget surplus left..."
entries.dialogueText: “We have a good budget surplus left for investments and other needs. Very good.”
